facts.where: section 3.3 Metrics
facts.quote: we report cost based on the following formula: input + cache-write + 0.1 ⋅ cache-read + 5 ⋅ output \text{input}+\text{cache-write}+0.1\cdot\text{cache-read}+5\cdot\text{output}
facts.note: cost = effective tokens relative to the family's oracle run (NOT dollars): weights approximate Claude Opus 4.8 per-token rates (output 5x, cache read 0.1x fresh input, cache-write as fresh input); the single-configuration Claude Opus 4.8 results include cache-write tokens in the input term

facts.value: Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.8 is evaluated on the 85 instances built on SWE-Bench Pro v1
facts.where: section 3.4 Evaluation sets
facts.quote: Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.8 is evaluated on the 85 instances built on SWE-Bench Pro v1
facts.note: 85 instances = 50 contradictory + 35 complementary; Seeds = manually constructed instances, Gen. = model-generated (silver) instances

facts.where: Table 5 caption
facts.quote: Pass rate (%) and relative cost of Claude Opus 4.8 across all 19 scenarios, on its 85 instances (SWE-Bench Pro v1).

facts.value: Table 5: Pass rate (%) and relative cost of Claude Opus 4.8 across all 19 scenarios, on its 85 instances (SWE-Bench Pro v1).
facts.where: Table 5 caption
facts.quote: Table 5: Pass rate (%) and relative cost of Claude Opus 4.8 across all 19 scenarios, on its 85 instances (SWE-Bench Pro v1). Pass is the fraction of instances whose combined patch passes the scored test group (contradictory: union of both sides’ tests; complementary: the integration test). Cost is mean effective tokens ( Section 3.3 ) relative to that family’s oracle run.
facts.note: Pass = share of instances whose combined patch passes the scored test group; Cost = mean effective tokens relative to the family oracle run; columns per family: Seeds, Gen., All, Cost
